# Deliver approved plan acceptance cases

These expected cases are defined before skill implementation. They are not performed observations. The evaluator drives actual independent Codex subjects, using the session's inherited model/effort and the actual installed final skill. The delivered skill delegates no runtime steps. Every evaluator-provided fixture answer/approval must say **TEST ONLY** and name its disposable project/feature; it never approves Farmboy work or accepts its result.

## Setup and observation

Use isolated disposable Spec Kit projects with their own guidance, constitution, roadmap/pointer, spec/plan/tasks, project verification command and installed existing capability copies. All Git actions/approvals in fixtures are test-only. Preserve unrelated changes and normal Git settings/hooks; do not force Git failures, add a new harness dependency or install tools. Source assertions supplement actual observations, never replace them. Record actual commands, file/status/commit results, subject/evaluator identity, source version, real question/answer timing and limits in the feature's ordinary acceptance evidence. Preserve intermediate evidence after source changes and rerun affected cases on final source.

## Case matrix

The source references cover all22 spec acceptance scenarios and the seven success outcomes.

| Case | Source | Setup and required actual observation |
|---|---|---|
| Positive conversation approval | US1/AC1; SC-001/002 | TEST ONLY approval of fixture spec/full plan; actual implement and verification, then prescribed convergence/closeout. No repeated routine OK. |
| Existing-note approval | FR-002; US1/AC1 | Fixture-local content-identifying approval note; no mandatory second conversational approval/register. |
| Missing/changed approval | US1/AC2 | Missing full-plan approval or materially changed meaning; stop before effects, no inferred approval from checklist/answer/Goal. |
| Identity and prerequisite | US1/AC2 | Conflicting explicit/pointer identity or unverified dependency; stop, do not choose another feature. |
| Missing command/required hook | US1/AC3 | Fixture lacks a required capability or mandatory hook cannot run; exact blocked outcome, no install/substitution/emitted-label success. |
| Unrelated work | US1/AC4; US3/AC3 | Preexisting unrelated staged/unstaged file; preserve its bytes/index and exclude it from delivery commit. |
| Missing behavior | US2/AC1 | Actual installed converge appends missing work after implement; actual follow-up implement/check/reassessment resolves it. |
| Severity disguise/optional | US2/AC2 | Required missing behavior described as LOW/optional remains required; a truly non-required suggestion is disclosed without a polishing loop. |
| Flow-back | US2/AC3 | Accepted in-scope discovery updates only current affected artifacts before dependent work; historical merged feature meaning untouched. |
| Material question | US2/AC4 | Genuine unanswered fixture product decision; actual saved INCOMPLETE boundary, no invented answer. Supply only labeled TEST ONLY actual reply after the real stop. |
| Stale pass | US2/AC5 | Change affected artifact after a real pass; fresh verification/reassessment required. |
| Real closeout | US3/AC1 | Actual attributable roadmap-debrief, relevant one-source-at-a-time wiki-ingest and lint; coherent docs/evidence. |
| Closeout issue | US3/AC2 | In-scope issue repaired/refreshed; material conflict or unavailable check remains honest input/blocker. |
| Final scoped commit | US3/AC3/4; SC-004 | Implemented roadmap update plus all scoped artifacts included in final local commit; unrelated work preserved; success reported after actual Git success. No intentionally dirty status tail or receipt commit. |
| No false acceptance | US3/AC5 | Checks/debrief/silence do not authorize verified/scope/dependency/governance changes. |
| Separate actual acceptance | US3/AC6 | Only after TEST ONLY explicit applicable fixture result acceptance, separately selected ordinary action may record verified; delivery itself does not. No implied merge/push. |
| Incomplete boundary | US3/AC7 | INCOMPLETE/Goal outcome does not claim successfully recorded delivery or inferred verified. Ordinary actual errors reported honestly; no forced commit-error experiment. |
| Partial resume | US4/AC1 | Real partial work/accepted answer/checked evidence preserved; resume missing/affected work, same task identities. |
| Pending review | US4/AC2 | Valid existing candidate/pending result review; present rather than regenerate/commit again/infer acceptance. |
| Native settled endpoint | US4/AC3; SC-007 | Evaluator separately selects matching bounded fixture Goal; actual saved result, supported native complete/readback before review wait. |
| Native input endpoint | US4/AC4 | Actual required decision, saved INCOMPLETE/exact input/artifacts/work/issues/next action; complete/read back matching bounded Goal before requesting answer. |
| Actual answer continuation | US4/AC5 | After complete readback, driver supplies TEST ONLY answer and separately selects ordinary continuation; prior Goal stays complete/unchanged, no new Goal. |
| Native exclusions | US4/AC6 | Unmet delivery-only objective, unknown helper failure or missing supported control cannot count as successful human-input handoff; preserve actual limitation. |
| Complete lifecycle/portability | FR-015; SC-006 | Observe actual001→002→003 interactions, genuine clarification/spec/full-plan review, repair, closeout and resume in Farmboy and disposable project. Record bootstrap/self-hosting limitations honestly; never count future closing-commit evidence as already performed or recurse delivery to manufacture it. |

No numeric attempt limit, counter/reset semantics, score, runtime persistence, controller or accounting system is part of the fixtures or delivered workflow. Actual supported native APIs only; no host DB mutation/bypass.
